reviews.text: A very nice experience for my nervous pug, who came out cleaner and smelling a whole lot better.  Heartily recommend Elsie and the rest of her team!
Stevie Joe, the old English sheepdog says..." There is nothing like a trip to see master groomer Elsie at Pawfect Spa to make a girl feel and look her most beautiful!"

First time client at Pawfect today. My goldendoodle needed a full grooming. I am very appreciative of the consideration given upon arrival to our appointment. Elsie listened to my concerns and what I wanted for Marlo. She is a true professional and I’m happy we discovered another great dog grooming artist. Thank you!

My dog desperately needed a nail trim and wasn't able to get it done before I left for a trip and left my dog with my brother. I was able to book a nail appointment quickly and easily remotely and sent my dog-sitter! They did a great job and he's so nervous.
Elsie and team always does a fantastic job with my dog! Highly recommended.

Incredibly professional and deeply knowledgeable about breed-specific grooming needs and how they should look (either for showing or just standard grooming).

They walked us through how our dog’s coat grows and gave us great maintenance tips for home, even showing us the right tools to use and didn't do it in a sales-y way. Just genuinely seemed to want to teach us.

The groom itself was outstanding. We are thrilled with the results and will definitely continue to bring our terrier.

We took our cat, Oreo to Pawfect. Loved how professional the team was. One tiny thing I noticed was the amount of loose hair on his body which could have been cleaned better. But overall, it was a safe experience without worrying about what they will do with my cat. Elsie was super warm and friendly ❤️

Brought my doggie here for a nail trim and the service was great! Very friendly and made sure to ask questions about her temperament to ensure she was taken care of :) I'm pleased we've found a new neighbourhood groomer!

Our sensitive and sometimes grumpy senior border terrier Chloe received a perfect grooming in this salon a couple of days ago, where she was transformed from a scruffy terrier into a polished puppy looking dog.  Thank you, Elsie.
Hi Briseida, thanks for giving us a 5 stars review.  Look forward to seeing you and Milo next time.  Thanks.  😊  …

Can you explain to me how it took you 5 hours to bathe and brush the same cat I just bathed and brushed in an hour?  With same coat condition and all.  How can you justify $500 for an $85 groom?  You guys are rinsing people.  It's a shame.  A boston terrier is $168 mind you short haired at that.  Absolutely awful what you guys are doing.  You are holding animals for 5 hours and pretending it took you 5 hours to do.  Its very dishonest.

We’ve been taking our girl to Pawfect Spa since she was a puppy, and they’ve been amazing from day one. They always do a fantastic job, and she comes home looking perfectly like herself every time.  Highly recommend!
Friendly and professional staff, clean facility, and my corgi Hobbes looks more handsome than ever.

Took my 7 old month puppy to have his first ever hand stripping and I couldn’t be happier with the results! Elsie & team not only knew what they were doing (which is not that easy to find), but also sent mr pictures throughout the process to ensure my desired results were met. They took a chewed toothbrush and returned a little gentleman!💕

Having had the opportunity to have several other groomers look after my boy, I can say that Pawfect is by far the crème de la crème of dog groomers. Elsie and her team always do an impeccable job and I'd recommend this place to any dog owner on the planet. The place is very clean, and the staff is friendly, knowledgeable and helpful -- all under the evident superb leadership of Elsie. Elsie is not a groomer -- she is an artist!

Update: June 23, 2026: The experience has become even better—as if that were ever possible. Elsie and her team are still rocking, with the bonus now that the new Micro Roast Cafe beside Pawfect is amazing! Excellent coffee, wonderful owners and inviting decor. And dogs are allowed to go in. It can't be any more marvellous than that!

The people at Pawfect Spa are really kind and care a lot about the high quality of their grooming skills. They pay a lot of attention. to the details and now have a cute cafe next door for the dog parents.

Our dog is always happy to go into their shop and to see the staff.

thank you Pawfect Spa for many years of wonderful service.

We took our 12 week old Shih-Poo puppy Winston here for his first groom. Elsie was so professional and sent pictures throughout the process to make sure we approved. Winston looked and smelled amazing after his appointment. We will be going to Elsie and her team for many years to come. I 100% can't say enough good things about our experience.
They know how to handle dogs 🧡 …

Five stars is not high enough a rating! Elsie and the team are absolutely fantastic! Our Border Terrier requires hand stripping, and has sensitive skin. He also had a previous bad grooming experience, which left him scared to go in. At Pawfect Spa, he was not only beautifully groomed, but clearly treated extremely well--when we picked him up, he was is normal, happy, tail-wagging self! An absolute first for him post grooming! Excellent customer service and communication, professional, knowledgeable, and kind--if you want exceptional and highly professional top-class grooming for your fur baby, Pawfect Spa is for you!
Excellent service, and a very friendly owner.

Elsie and her team always do a fantastic job!  Our dogs come out looking even more adorable (if that is possible) and smelling super clean.  We’ve been going here for more than 8 years and I couldn’t imagine going any other place.  I have full confidence in how well our dogs are looked after and groomed!  You won’t regret it!

Hi Hijoe, We are sorry to see your one star rating.  We always strive to provide the best possible care for our furry clients and their families.  We were unable to identify your visit based on the information available.  We’d appreciate to learn more about your experience and address any concern.  Please feel free to contact us directly at 416-962-7721 x0 directly or email us at info@pawfectspa.com.  Thanks, Pawfect Spa.

Honestly, I was never disappointed with their services. It was beyond my expectations, especially when it came to my puppy’s fur. I am very satisfied, and the outcome was amazing. Looking forward to coming back again. Elsie and the staff are excellent.

We had such a wonderful experience with Pawfect. We are beyond happy with the grooming service for our dog. The team went above and beyond—they took care of so many little details, including things we didn’t even think of ourselves. You can really tell they genuinely care about the dogs and take pride in their work.

Most importantly, our dog absolutely loved the staff and felt comfortable the whole time, which means everything to us. We truly appreciate the love, patience, and professionalism. Highly recommend!
Elsie and the team are so talented and caring. My golden doodle looks fabulous every single time!
Hi Elaine, Thanks for giving us a 5 stars review.  Look forward to seeing Ducky next time.  😊 …
Hi Austin, thanks for giving us a 5 stars review.  Look forward to seeing Spencer next time.  😊 …
My cat has challenging behavior and normally gets nail trim while heavily sedated. So happy this worked, and plan to do monthly nail trims here

Wow!  Great out comes!  I have been looking for a groomer for my two little dogs.  A place where the team can be creative, take the time to understand what I am looking for, make suggestions based on the dog and the look we would like to achieve.
Pawfect Spa was exactly what I was looking for!  They did a great job, imagine my dogs are 4 and 5 years old and this is the first time that I was happy with the grooming.  They took their time, their coats are so soft and perfectly aligned with their body shape!

Thank you to a great team, we will see you soon!

Promise it’s worth try this team out, u will be pleasantly surprised!

Can’t recommend Elsie and Pawfect Spa highly enough!  Very few groomers have the skills and experience to hand strip. Elsie stripped our Border Terrier from a blowout scruffy beaver to a gorgeous breed standard coat. She was honest and forthcoming about the time and cost required. She was gentle but efficient with the grooming and our border seemed calm through the process. She came out looking gorgeous.

Very pleased with my first experience taking my cat to Pawfect Spa! They were very accommodating and took the time to thoroughly answer all the questions I had as a new client. As for my kitty - she's tired but perfectly well groomed and wasn't stressed from the experience! She looks AMAZING!! I'll definitely be coming back with her and my other cat!

Elsie and PAWfect Spa team are the best! After doing a great job with Misio, a toy poodle I was looking after for a couple of years, now was the time for my new Tiny Toy Poodle puppy. As always, Elsie had great advice for me and did an amazing job with Ponchoosh. Thank you!
Hi Cynthia, Thanks for giving us a 5 stars review.  Look forward to seeing you guys next time.
They were great and fast in accommodating a last minute cat nail trim

At first I thought it was a bit pricey, but it’s so worth it. My dog is quite old, and Elsie took such nice care of her. I’m so relieved to have found somewhere I can bring Nessie in her old age so she can still look and feel fresh. Very pleased with the service.
Amazing grooming! My dog smelled incredible afterward. I couldn’t stop sniffing him.

This was our first visit to Pawfect Spa and it was excellent. We only had a nail trim, however Fergus is normally not very good when someone touches his paws/nails. Apparently he felt completely safe and was a perfect boy in their hands. Thank you, we will be back!
Highly recommended here!
We always have the best experience with Elsie and her team!!! I don’t trust many groomers but they have earned it time and again!
The pawfect place! This is the place. Come one, come all. You’ll leave with a beautifully groomed pet and if lucky another delightful surprise 😉 …
Took my new puppy and they did a fantastic job, the scared little guy was so calm and happy with them! They also gave me amazing tips. Felt like family. Will always take my dog there!
We were very happy with our experience. Everyone is very friendly.
Thanks Priscilla for giving us a 5 stars review.  Look forward to seeing you and Sadie next time.  😊 …
Highly recommended. My dog is comfortable in here. Their service is excellent.

Pawfect Spa is like no other grooming salon! I have had terrible experiences at other places, and once I have found Pawfect Spa, I was so relieved. The owner and the staff are real professionals, and so caring for their furry customers. I have moved to Quebec 2 years ago, and go back to Pawfect Spa every time I visit friends and family in Toronto. 🥰
Hi Les, Thanks for giving us a 5 stars review.  Look forward to seeing you and Bella next time.  😊 …
Hi Kaiserin, Thanks for giving us a 5 stars review.  Look forward to seeing you guys next time.  😊 …
Very happy that Pawfect has moved to our neighborhood.  Elsie is a skilled groomer and our Wire Haired Fox Terrier came home looking show-ready.  Thank you, Elsie!
Excellent service! Highly recommended
Hi Alex, Thank you for giving us a 5 stars review.  Congrats again for your new puppy.  Look forward to seeing Charlie again on his next groom.  Elsie

Thank you so much you’re did amazing job on my cat her Lion haircut is amazing it’s so beautiful I’ll recommend displays for everybody to go and visit the staff is so amazing answering the questions and giving advice wonderful job thank you sooo much Ella is very happy kitty now
👏👏👏👍👍👍 …
My kitten had a great experience! Great communication with owner and staff. Very nice job on the trimming - practical trim and looks nice too!

Had an amazing experience at the Pawfect Spa! Elsie was so incredibly thorough - making sure we would achieve our dream cut for our Cocker, Ziggy. Appreciative to the whole team who took such great care with him. He was very matted & had lots of dead hair, which was meticulously removed - leaving us with a happy, beautiful pup ❤️

Elsie and her team always do a fantastic job with my Cavalier King Charles Spaniel, Jackson. They are very good about grooming your dog according to breed standards while also incorporating all of your personal requests/modifications. They also provide regular updates with pictures. I highly recommend Pawfect Spa.

Such an amazing experience with this groomer! I’m so happy with how my puppy’s grooming turned out—she looks adorable. The care and attention to detail really stood out. I’ll definitely be coming back. 10/10 would highly recommend!
They provided excellent grooming and care—my furry friend came home looking and feeling great!
They did an amazing job grooming my pet—she came back looking clean, happy, and adorable!
Amazing service and extremely accommodating. I’ll be using this grooming service regularly for my pet and highly recommend!

I recently took my dog to Elsie and her team for grooming, and I couldn't be happier! They are incredibly experienced and attentive, making the whole process stress-free for my pup. After his haircut, he seemed so calm and relaxed, which speaks volumes about the care he received. He looks absolutely adorable with his new cut! I highly recommend for anyone looking for top-notch grooming services.
Very good hand stripping
Elsie is amazing groomer! This place is Best of Toronto and worth every penny!

Helpful professional staff, focused on hygenie and efficient serving: my large retriever always comes back with well groomed nails, and excellent hair trims. Scheduling is flexible and they are good about advising me of upcoming busy times when my dog might ve do for a treatment to help me book ahead for convenience. Easy to communicate with on line and by text.

Pawfect Spa did excellent grooming with my loving Amber. Pet Smart doesn't want to accept Amber anymore. They said because of her behaviour. Thank God finally we found Pawfect Spa. I asked them if they are willing to accept Amber after they did her grooming. They said Amber is welcome anytime. The staff at Pawfect Spa did a great excellent job for our loving Amber. Even the staff entertained me very well. I recommend Perfect Spa as a best place for pet grooming.
Very organized and timely service. My furry baby left super clean smelling like roses lol

I can't say enough good things about Pawfect spa! From the moment I walked in, I felt welcomed and knew my furry friend was in excellent hands.  The staff is incredibly friendly, knowledgeable, and genuinely care about animals. They took the time to listen to my specific requests for my dog's grooming and offered helpful suggestions.
My dog came out looking absolutely amazing!  They did a fantastic job with the full groom service. Her fur has never been so soft and they gave her the cutest bandana!.  Beyond the great grooming, I appreciated how gentle and patient they were with my dog, who can be a little nervous at the groomer.
Pawfect spa is clean, professional, and provides top-notch service.  Their prices are reasonable, especially considering the quality of care.  I highly recommend them to any pet owner looking for a fantastic grooming experience.  We've found our forever groomer!

This spa is the absolute best!! They take the best care of my verrrrryyyy fluffy husky mix and she is usually there for 4 hours!

Great Value 🤍🐾

I cannot say enough about Elsie and her team at Pawfect Spa. They are incredible! We have been taking our dog to them for the past 3 years and they always do the best job. We would not go anywhere else. Our dog does NOT like grooming but they always manage to take care of him and make him look amazing and clean!

I just wanted to send a HUGE THANK YOU for the wonderful grooming job Elsie and her Team done on my puppy chow chow, Asher. He looks amazing and cute after 4hrs full groom, and I'm sure he enjoys without all that extra hair! Your professionalism and tender care on my boy's safety and well being gave me peace of mind especially for the 1st time visit. Will sure be back. Keep up with your good work!

I’m so impressed with the quality and care for my cat.  It was definitely worth the hour drive to go here.  Linus doesn’t let me groom him and given his coat, he requires regular grooming.  I’m so happy with how his treatments turned out. Plus he smells amazing :)Will be booking my other cat in very soon!  Thanks again !

This business is does not stay open as its hours say on there website they leave early when they want to because they don't want to pay their employees for the day.they are unreliable and can never have the appointment when you want it,they try to change appointments which is sometimes not convenient for the owners of their pets
Over priced lol
I don’t know if my cat is happy , but I am :) great service . Thank you
Hi Robin, thanks for giving us a 5 stars review.  Look forward to seeing you and Scout next time.  😊 …
Hi Pam, Thank you for giving us a 5 stars review.  Look forward to seeing Scarlett again next time.  Elsie
Poor Casper had badly matted hair… so we decided on a Lion cut at pawfect spa… he was a bit of a difficult customer but the results are great! Thanks to the entire staff!

This is the second time that my dog Ziggy had a haircut and a deshedding treatment at Pawfect Spa. The staff are very knowledgeable, caring and courteous. Although still not very familiar with the staff and the treatment, Ziggy left the spa happy, relaxed and sporting a wonderful haircut. The deshedding has made a huge difference and I highly recommend this service for dogs who shed. Thank you again to the staff at Pawfect for their professionalism and dedication to their clients. We will definitely be back!
They do a great job grooming my dog despite her not liking the grooming process and her being difficult. .
Elsie and team are great.  Very positive experience.

I highly recommend Pawfect Spa.. amazing response time, service, and lovely staff/groomer. I had the pleasure of speaking and working with Elsie in scheduling my dog (Sadie) for a grooming. They took great care of her as she was very happy and tired from the long day of grooming. She got a full groom and de-matting. I will definitely be continuing with this groomer for the foreseeable future. Worth every penny paid.
I use this place to socialize my dog. She loves it. I recommend
